text:
Yara: flagging a nav IA question for the regroup — when a user lands on a deep-link (e.g. /teams/sol/workspaces/7/datasets/census), should the left sidebar: (A) silently reveal the Datasets group and highlight the item, (B) expand with animation and move keyboard focus to the item, or (C) only render the highlight without changing focus/expanded state?
Quinn: accessibility-first: expand+reveal and ensure the target element is focusable. otherwise screen readers might not find it. set aria-expanded on the group and aria-current on the item.
Diego: +1 but UX caveat: if we force focus, the browser may scroll and the user loses context. suggestion: expand group, set tabindex="-1" on target, focus with preventScroll, then call scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' }). that avoids big jumps.
Harper: also show a subtle ephemeral banner when expansion was triggered by an external link: "Opened via link: Datasets expanded" with an Undo action that collapses and stores the user's previous collapsed state. nobody likes unexpected UI changes without an affordance.
Yara: good catch. decision discussion: should deep-links override a user's manual collapse preference? i lean override on initial navigation (explicit intent), but persist manual toggles afterward in localStorage so the app respects the user's preference subsequently.
Quinn: agree. implementation detail: router should keep canonical paths (/teams/:org/workspaces/:id/datasets/:datasetId). the router mount hook translates the path into nav open+select. avoid query-state for visibility if possible.
Diego: animation & motion: animate expansion with a short 100-140ms slide+fade for orientation, but respect prefers-reduced-motion and fall back to instant reveal. also ensure the animation doesn't reflow the main content or cause layout shifts.
Harper: keyboard flow to test in PR: Tab -> focus goes to nav region -> ArrowDown arrives at group header -> RightArrow/Enter expands -> ArrowDown into items -> selected item gets programmatic focus (preventScroll) -> Enter activates. test with NVDA + VoiceOver and Safari/Chrome.
Quinn: a11y specifics: role="navigation" on the container, groups as lists, not role=tree. use aria-current="page" for the selected item. add aria-live polite announcement when expansion happens via deep-link: "Navigation: Datasets expanded, item selected" so assistive tech users get context.
Diego: edge-case: if the selected item is far down and revealing causes the left nav to scroll, make sure the left nav scroll is contained (not the whole page). use scrollIntoView on the nav container. also implement focus({ preventScroll: true }) before calling scrollIntoView to avoid double jumps.
NavBot: added checklist entry A11Y-303 "deep-link reveal + focus + undo toast" and linked to regression matrix.
Yara: proposed microcopy for breadcrumbs: "Team • Workspace • Datasets • Census" with middle dot separators. tooltip/aria-label for truncated crumbs. screen-reader label: "Breadcrumbs: Team, Workspace, Datasets, Census".
Harper: testing notes: include a keyboard gif in the PR showing the expand + focus (and a reduced-motion variant). include a short video demonstrating the Undo toast working and localStorage persistence.
Quinn: action items: (1) router mount conversion from path -> nav open/select (Quinn), (2) implement focus with preventScroll + scrollIntoView nearest inside nav (Diego), (3) ephemeral "Opened via link" toast with Undo + remember manual collapse state (Harper), (4) breadcrumbs copy + tooltip + SR label (Yara), (5) add a11y regression test A11Y-303 (Quinn).
Yara: I'll update the Figma frames and open the PR with screenshots + keyboard gif. tagging @Quinn @Diego @Harper — thanks! :sparkles:
